top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks to Katori and Ye: the magic-wavelength condition cancels the trap light shift so many atoms are interrogated at once with ion-level systematic control, a new regime that independent laboratories in several countries reproduce and compare at the 1e-18 level, with the cleanest two-name credit on the list. The citation names the lattice and magic wavelength, so it is distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-ion prizes. P002 is a close second: mature and well confirmed, but the three-name allocation leaves out Bernevig, Hughes, Zhang, Hasan, Fu and Moore, and it follows the 2016 topology prize. A prize is preferable to no award.
